hoaxes.title: Google will sell Gemini 4 Carbon as a monthly plan that patches your home Wi-Fi router
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Gemini 4 Carbon is a security-focused model, with early access limited to selected cyber defenders.

hoaxes.title: Dune: Part Three IMAX screenings will blow fine sand into the auditorium during sandworm scenes
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Dune: Part Three opens December 18, and BFI IMAX 70mm screenings sold 33,000 tickets in a day.

hoaxes.title: Xbox update adds a Mythic achievement for keeping a game disc in its case for a year
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Xbox update adds Mythic achievements and a new way to convert disc licenses to digital.

hoaxes.title: Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro ships with a stylus that docks inside the Dynamic Island
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The touchscreen MacBook Pro doesn't support Apple Pencil; it starts at $2,899 and launches November 6.
